articles.title: Hero Rat Gets a Giant Statue!
articles.summary: A rat named Magawa saved lives by sniffing out landmines. Now he has a huge statue in Cambodia!

articles.title: Teen Swimmer Breaks a 23-Year-Old Record!
articles.summary: Sienna Toohey, 17, swam the 100m breaststroke in 1:05.97, beating a record set by legend Leisel Jones in 2003.

articles.title: K-Pop Duo V8 Drops Debut EP with Pharrell!
articles.summary: SEVENTEEN members The 8 and Vernon form V8, releasing their first EP on June 29 with production by Pharrell Williams.
